Our Club

Every runner has a pace. We help you find yours.

PACELINE is a running club for people training toward something specific — a first 5K, a marathon PR, or just a habit that sticks. Every plan is coached, every run is logged, and every pace group runs together.

Training

Every run has a job to do

TRACK

Speed & Track

Interval work and track sessions built to raise your top-end pace, not just your mileage.

LONG RUN

Endurance

Progressive long-run programming for 10K through marathon distance, paced and fueled properly.

OFF-ROAD

Trail & Terrain

Technical footing, climbing, and pacing strategy for runners moving off the pavement.

EASY PACE

Recovery Runs

Low-intensity mileage and mobility work that keeps you running instead of rehabbing.
